_meta.note: Update last_reviewed and re-check affected rules whenever any upstream trigger changes.

R1_language_english_only.description: All frontmatter fields and body content must be in English

R2_reference_english_required.description: Every references/ file must have an English primary version

R3_reference_multilingual.description: Reference files may have language variant files alongside the English primary

R4_naming_kebab_case.description: All component identifiers must use lowercase kebab-case

R5_frontmatter_no_nonstandard_fields.description: Skill and agent frontmatter must not include command-only or unsupported fields

R6_tool_scoping_least_privilege.description: allowed-tools may be space-separated, comma-separated, or a YAML list; apply principle of least privilege

R7_no_emoji_in_structure.description: No emoji in section headings, frontmatter fields, or procedural step labels

R8_description_multiline_syntax.description: Descriptions over 80 characters must use >- YAML block scalar syntax

R9_no_hardcoded_credentials.description: No API keys, tokens, passwords, or secrets in any plugin file

R10_reference_file_naming.description: Reference files use descriptive, specific, kebab-case topic names (max 40 chars, no generic names)

R12_code_block_language_specifier.description: All fenced code blocks must include a language identifier (```yaml, ```json, ```bash)

R13_skillmd_line_limit.description: SKILL.md total line count — tiered severity by threshold (see references/size-rules.md)

R14_references_one_level_deep.description: No nested subdirectories in references/ — only references/<file>.md is valid

R15_no_human_documentation_files.description: No README.md, CHANGELOG.md, INSTALLATION.md, or similar human-facing docs in skill directories

R16_progressive_disclosure_order.description: Quick Start section must appear before detailed workflow or reference sections in SKILL.md

R17_no_bare_urls.description: All hyperlinks must use named reference syntax — text in brackets, URL in parentheses

R18_code_block_line_limit.description: Inline fenced code block line count — tiered severity by threshold (see references/size-rules.md)

R19_canonical_path_resolution.description: Resolve the target component's actual file path and verify no duplicate/shadow copy of the same named component exists in another scope (project, plugin, or user skill directories)

R20_duplicate_fact_sweep.description: When a canonical enum, threshold, or field value changes, sweep the plugin tree for other occurrences of the old value in sibling files and flag any not updated

R21_skill_description_size.description: SKILL.md description/when_to_use/combined length — tiered severity by threshold (see references/size-rules.md)

R22_argument_frontmatter_consistency.description: argument-hint/arguments frontmatter must match $ARGUMENTS/$N/$name usage in the body (see references/argument-consistency.md)

R23_external_reference_policy.description: External references (companies, GitHub orgs, marketplaces, plugins, skills, repositories) must be classified whitelist/blacklist; unclassified and broken references are flagged (see references/external-reference-policy.md)

languages.notes: Add or remove codes in 'additional' to control which language variants are permitted

color.notes: magenta is no longer listed in current platform docs; flag as deprecated, not invalid

permissionMode.notes: manual is an alias for default, introduced in Claude Code v2.1.200+
